title: Chap shoro
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.item: Chakki ka atta (Whole wheat flour) sifted
items.raw: Chakki ka atta (Whole wheat flour) sifted 2 & ½ Cup
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Zeera (Cumin seeds) roasted & crushed ½ tbs
Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required

items.item: Hara dhania & Podina (Fresh coriander & Mint leaves) chopped
items.raw: Hara dhania & Podina (Fresh coriander & Mint leaves) chopped 2-3 tbs

items.item: Apricot or Walnut oil for frying or cooking oil of your choice
items.raw: Apricot or Walnut oil for frying or cooking oil of your choice

steps.instruction: In bowl,add add wheat flour,salt and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein chakki ka atta aur namak dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and knead until dough is formed,cover and let it rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein,dhak dein aur 15 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add apricot or walnut oil,onion and sauté until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein apricot or walnut oil aur pyaz dal dein aur translucent hunay tak sauté ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken mince and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken qeema dal ker rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker 2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,cumin seeds,black pepper crushed and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,zeera aur kali mirch crushed dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.
Tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix well,cover and cook on medium flame for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker darmiyani anacch per 8-10 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: In water,add saffron strands and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani mein zafran dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add dissolve saffron and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Dissolve zafran dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,fresh coriander & mint leaves and mix well for 1-2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz,hara dhania & podina dal ker 1-2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Knead dough again,grease hands with oil,take a small dough and make a ball,sprinkle flour and roll out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough ko dubara ghond lein,haath ok oil sa grease karein aur chota dough la ker ball bana lein,atta chirak dein aur rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.
Atta chirak dein aur fold ker ka side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Roll out another dough with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Ek aur dough ko rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: Add cooked chicken filling and spread evenly.
steps.romanUrdu: Cooked chicken filling dal ker pheela lein.

steps.instruction: Place rolled dough and prick with skewer,fold and seal the edges (makes 3).
steps.romanUrdu: Rolled dough rakh ker skewer sa prick ker lein aur edges ko fold ker ka seal ker lein (makes 3).

steps.instruction: Heat griddle and cooked rolled dough from both sides then fry in apricot or walnut oil & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Tawa garam karein aur rolled dough ko dono sides sa paka lein phir apricot or walnut oil mein fry ker lein & serve karein!

ogDescription: Chap shoro, a famous traditional dish of Hunza, Gilgit Baltistan. We learned about it from the locals and now bring you the Food Fusion version of Chap
